text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Excited~? Thrilled~?

text_block_list.name: Tsuyoshi & Teio
text_block_list.text: Valentine's Cookiiiiing!

text_block_list.name: Tsuyoshi's Older Sister
text_block_list.text:
And so, I'm Tsu-chan's big sister, serving 
as your instructor today! I'm a pastry 
chef in training♪

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Or rather, Tsuru-chan's big sis! Why did 
you decide to become a pastry chef!? Even 
though you're an Umamusume!

text_block_list.name: Tsuyoshi's Older Sister
text_block_list.text:
Hehehe, well that's because~... I realized 
I'm a genius pastry chef!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, big sis. Even though you're 
busy with your own school.

text_block_list.name: Tsuyoshi's Older Sister
text_block_list.text:
Not at all, it's for Tsu-chan! You give 
chocolate to thank the people who've taken 
care of you, right?

text_block_list.name: Tsuyoshi's Older Sister
text_block_list.text:
...We really have to cherish our 
connections!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Today, Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi brought some 
sweets. To make the most of it, I set out 
my prized black tea on the table, when...

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, Trainer! Thank you for even 
preparing tea for me!
choice_data_list: No, no, thank you for the sweets!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe... Go ahead and look inside too! 
That one on the desk is the chocolate cake 
my big sister taught me how to make!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Valentine's is a day to share bonds and 
gratitude. To cherish our connections, I 
made it circular!

text_block_list.name: Elderly Doctor
text_block_list.text: Ho-ho-ho. Fate, is it...?

text_block_list.name: Elderly Doctor
text_block_list.text:
Come to think of it, it was fate that 
brought us together as a team. You scouted 
me a year ago, Trainer-san.

text_block_list.name: Elderly Doctor
text_block_list.text:
"I want to train Umamusume who look up to 
Rudolf"... It all started with those 
words.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: ...? Those words were the trigger?

text_block_list.name: Elderly Doctor
text_block_list.text:
"...Ho-ho-ho. The truth is, I also have 
someone I look up to~."

text_block_list.name: Elderly Doctor
text_block_list.text:
Back when I was just an ordinary doctor, I 
happened to turn on the TV and saw an 
exceptionally strong Umamusume in a race.

text_block_list.name: Elderly Doctor
text_block_list.text:
Even with zero knowledge, I was struck by 
how strong she was. Ever since then, I've 
looked forward to the big race days...

text_block_list.name: Elderly Doctor
text_block_list.text:
However, after a certain day, no matter 
what race came around, nothing more was 
ever heard of that Umamusume's triumphs.

text_block_list.name: Elderly Doctor
text_block_list.text:
When I looked into it, it turned out she 
had sustained an injury during an away 
race.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
...Injured while traveling for a race. 
That Umamusume is—

text_block_list.name: Elderly Doctor
text_block_list.text:
Even though it didn't involve me directly, 
I felt regret. Wondering if there was 
something I could have done to help.

text_block_list.name: Elderly Doctor
text_block_list.text:
I worried, full of regret... And after 
some time had passed, I met you, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Elderly Doctor
text_block_list.text:
"I was invited with the words, 'There is 
an Umamusume who can become just like 
Symboli Rudolf.'"

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
choice_data_list: So you're a fan of Rudolf too, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Elderly Doctor
text_block_list.text:
"I was just an ordinary fangirl, you see~ 
I didn't know the first thing about Tracen 
Academy."

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
“Still. That's why Sensei teamed up with 
Trainer-san, and—”

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: ...Amazing. This must be fate.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After seeing off the teacher, I tidy up 
the tea set. I have no particular plans 
after this.
choice_data_list: You can head home first, Tsuyoshi!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? No, I'll help you all the way to the 
end! Today is the day to show my gratitude 
to you, Trainer!
choice_data_list:
...You think? Well, maybe I'll take you up 
on that.

...Really? In that case, I might take you 
up on that.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Yes! Leave it to me! .........

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Um, you know! So many of the connections I 
have came about through the President and 
you, Trainer!
choice_data_list:
Ah! Come to think of it, did you give 
chocolate to the President too?

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Wah, I gave it to them! They immediately 
got the pun between "fate" and "five yen", 
and they laughed—

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
—No, wait! I wanted to talk to you 
properly before heading home today, 
Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: "...Um. I might be being selfish, but..."

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
I don't want to let go of any of the 
connections I hold in my hands right now.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
So, well... It might sound pretty cliché, 
but...

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
...Please continue to be with me moving 
forward.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: ...Because my Trainer is amazing.
choice_data_list:
Huh, where did this come from all of a 
sudden?

Huh, where did this come from all of a 
sudden?

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
It's not sudden at all. I'm thinking about 
it all the time!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
...Because someone like you was there, I 
was able to meet Sensei. And speak with 
the Student Council President.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
A life without you is something I can't 
bear to even think about. That's how 
important you are to me.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
...So, umm. This is just a hypothetical, 
but...

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
"Even if I grow up, even if I graduate 
from this academy."

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Is it okay if I come here? ...To see you, 
Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Ngh...! Yay!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
"When that time comes, I'll bring sweets 
just like today!"

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
"Let's eat cake again, too! Together with 
some delicious tea!"

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Please stay connected with me even when I 
become an adult!
